fund_name.description: Fund name as printed in the page header, e.g. 'Mega Cap Growth Index Fund'.

as_of_date.description: Schedule as-of date as printed after 'As of', e.g. 'March 31, 2026'.

holdings.description: Every holding row of the Schedule of Investments, in print order.

security_name.description: Security name as printed (without leading footnote markers).

marks.description: Leading superscript footnote markers, e.g. ['*'] or ['1'] or ['*','2'].

asset_class_percent.description: Percent of net assets printed on the class heading.

group_percent.description: Percent of net assets printed on the group heading.

face_amount_thousands.description: Face amount in $000 for fixed-income/repo rows (null otherwise).

inline_cost_thousands.description: Cost printed inline after the name as '(Cost $N)', in $000.

market_value_thousands.description: Market value in $000 (0 when printed as an em dash).

source_page.description: Page number as printed on the page where this holding row is printed. This document's printed page numbering is offset from the PDF page index; report the number printed on the page, not the PDF page position.
